nodes.label: Chat Document Viewer document presentation boundary
nodes.rationale: The viewer presents a document delivered in conversation with actions, editable title and description and replaceable content. It defines neither document anatomy nor file generation or fiscal rules; its main component remains 430:15516 and no document-type variants are created.

nodes.label: Native replaceable preview Slot
nodes.rationale: Native preview#430:0 preserves its key, stretchChildOnInsert and open cardinality. An instance may insert, remove, replace, reorder or empty preview children without losing actions or header. Search, visualization controls and Sticky Actions Table are replaceable product examples, not required anatomy.

nodes.label: Host controlled document actions
nodes.rationale: Typed React props map Title, Description and native preview to title, optional description and children. Secondary/Text medium Buttons delegate download, expand and close through optional host callbacks and disable without callbacks. expanded is host state, not file generation or an automatic dialog; host focus and conversation draft are preserved.

nodes.label: Viewer owned internal component token roles
nodes.rationale: Own viewer layers replace Body and Conversation Response bindings with chat-document-viewer component roles through semantic aliases to primitives. Buttons retain their family roles; new tokens have empty scopes while Body remains the only selector interface. Product preview content may use Body and official controls.

nodes.label: Bound tracking normalization from percent to pixels
nodes.rationale: Figma binding forces letterSpacing to PIXELS, so observed 0.1 percent becomes 0.02 px at title size 20 and 0.014 px at description size 14. Two shared Manrope Bold20 and Regular14 styles bind own tokens, keep AUTO line height and use distinct tracking primitives and aliases without changing Body tracking.

It preserves native Body#105:0 and Right sidebar#299:7 keys and adds shared native Document preview for the two new variants, leaving conversation, document and rail independently replaceable.

nodes.label: Conversation document expansion preserves host state

Restore, close and reopen preserve draft and focus; local callbacks do not simulate remote generation or successful download.
